name: Jugendherberge Dangl
beschreibung: Jugendherberge Dangl welcomes guests on the sunny outskirts of Pfunds in the Tyrolean Oberland, conveniently located near the border triangle of Austria, Switzerland, and Italy. The accommodation caters to sports clubs, hiking groups, school excursions, and budget-conscious travelers seeking practical amenities. Clean dormitory-style and private rooms are complemented by a communal lounge, ski storage, and gear-drying facilities. A generous morning breakfast buffet fuels outdoor adventures, with home-style evening meals available on request. In winter, top ski arenas such as Samnaun-Ischgl, Nauders, and Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis are within easy reach, while summer provides rich hiking and climbing opportunities.
kurzbeschreibung: Budget-friendly group lodge and youth hostel in Pfunds in the Tyrolean Oberland near the border triangle.
